format.file: {format, spec, cases: [case]}; every case runs on its own, from an empty engine, with risk inert (ignore_risk).
format.case: name, why, clock, dev_bounds, groups, labels, tokens, pools, events (as in c1b_signal_cases.json FORMAT), cost_scenario, expect_ops.
format.tokens: the mints table as c1b's, plus complete_slot (the token's historical completion, null: none) and pool (its PumpSwap pool, null: none), which the engine's graduation reads (engine.py:977-992).
format.cost_scenario: the journal's state 'cost_scenario' as paper.engine main writes it (json.dumps(asdict(scn), sort_keys=True), engine.py:1494): the base scenario of week2-defaults.yaml. Parse it with float_roundtrip.
format.expect_ops: every journal write of the five tables in the engine's order: ["put", table, row] with the table's columns (journal.py TABLES; null where the engine writes none) or ["delete", "positions", key]. The final positions table is empty.
format.integers: every integer fits i64; ret is a float, parse it with float_roundtrip.

SL: sells take it down, stop_loss. TM: no event after the entry; another pool's events advance the clock past the deadline (entry + 599), so the time exit is decided in the quiet gap (advance).

cases.name: curve_entry_failures
cases.why: CS: the entry slot's first tx buys 60T before us (q 0.5 of two txs): our fill is far below the expected one, entry_slippage (exits row, pnl -failed_tx). CN: the signal slot ends with a buy of every token left, so the state after it is complete: no_curve_state. CK: the curve completes at t + 1, before the entry: curve_complete.

cases.name: our_buy_completes
cases.why: G1 (no pool, never completed): our buy completes the curve at the entry; the sale goes to the seed pool at entry + 1, cf_graduation 1. G2: the same, with the token completed at the entry slot historically: still cf_graduation 1 (set by the fill). G3: the token's pool opens at entry + 10 and trades at its open + 1 in two txs: the sale fills there after the first (q 0.5 of the primary group). G4: its pool opens at entry + 10 and next trades at entry + 30: the sale on the pool's last state, exit_slot open + 1 still. G5: its pool opens at entry + 10 but never trades: no state, proceeds 0, the attempt counts. G6: its pool opens after the data: at the end of data the sale goes to the seed pool at the last slot + 1 (no decision slot).

cases.name: completion_during_the_hold
cases.why: H1, H2, H3: after our entry another trader's buy took all but 1T tokens; re-run after ours it takes what is left and completes the curve. H1 sells into the seed pool at that slot + 1 (cf_graduation 1); H2 waits for its pool, open at t + 150, and sells there at open + 1; H3 completed at that very slot historically, so cf_graduation is 0 (slot < complete_slot fails).

cases.name: h_flow_exits
cases.why: The feed starts an hour before the triggers (O trades at t0), so H's farm window is complete. At epoch 1042 the flow window is 1,120 slots and the cap 80,648. HO: a token sell 1,298 slots after the entry; end() decides on it: outflow (both H variants). HT: a token buy 80,000 slots after the entry keeps the flow positive at the last slot and at the deadline: time. HP: a 400 SOL token buy doubles the price: flow300_tp100_H6 takes profit, flow300_H6 (no tp) holds until end() decides the deadline, where the window is empty: outflow. K3 trades all three too.

cases.name: exits_that_fail
cases.why: FR: take_profit decided at t + 30; at t + 32 a 60 SOL token sell comes before our insertion (q 0.5 of two txs), so the sale misses the minimum and is tried again at a later decision (exit_attempts 2). NX: all liquidity is withdrawn at t + 105; every sale fails: the stop_loss decided in a quiet gap misses (attempt 1), end() decides the deadline and misses again (attempt 2), so exit_slot is NULL and proceeds 0. ES: a 100 SOL token buy before our insertion in the entry slot: entry_slippage.
